genxml.title: National DP83843 PHYTER 10/100 Mb/s transceiver, MII registers (Origin 300 IO-8)
genxml.doc: The MII management registers of the DP83843 transceiver on the Origin 300 IO-8 board. The IOC3 Ethernet controller reaches the part through its MII port, so only the registers a guest can read or write through that port are here. Offsets are MII register numbers, one per 16-bit register. The registers below are the ones the DP83843 datasheet, revision B, describes with bit meanings or reset values; the rest of the register map is not transcribed. The DP83840A that the Origin 200 carries is a different part with its own bit meanings for registers 0x17 and 0x18, and it is not described by this unit. Grades say how each item was derived from the datasheet; none of it was measured on a board, and reset values are unknown unless stated.

struct.name: LBR
struct.from: DP83843 revision B datasheet, loopback register, PDF pp. 59-62 (printed pp. 58-61), Table 21
struct.doc: Loopback register. Reset zero is the value in the nominal table for copper, nibble-mode straps. Bits 13 to 7 are bypass bits that the datasheet marks strap-dependent, so the reset of those bits on a board depends on its straps; the board's straps are unverified. Bit 6 is a digital loopback selection that the register table marks reserved and read only, which conflicts with a prose section on the same bit; it has no field here.
